extraChanges.note: The browser worker migrates native PDF loads, conversion kernels and Markdown return types. Detailed serialization/import evidence stays internal and is shared through InternalsVisibleTo. Reverse adapter references and lazy-load catalogs use OfficeIMO.Pdf.Word, OfficeIMO.Pdf.Excel and OfficeIMO.Pdf.PowerPoint. The shared front-door raw-HTML configuration preserves rich Markdown import without another renderer implementation.
